subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should OpenClaw add registerControlUiEntryPoint as a separate public plugin UI API with top-level launch modes, or fold its launch-token behavior into the existing Control UI tab descriptor seam?
rationale: This is a durable plugin SDK, Gateway protocol, and browser-security contract; automation can point out unsafe fallbacks, but maintainers must choose the permanent API and isolation model before third-party plugins depend on it.

options.title: Fold Into Tab Descriptor
options.body: Extend the existing plugin tab descriptor contract with token launch behavior, keep plugin pages sandboxed, and avoid a parallel public API.

options.title: Approve Separate API After Hardening
options.body: Keep registerControlUiEntryPoint, but require iframe-only opaque sandboxing, fail-closed launch errors, docs, and exact-head proof before merge.

options.title: Pause For RFC Consolidation
options.body: Leave this PR open but do not merge until the native plugin page and broader Control UI contribution RFCs settle the API shape.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Tab Descriptor
recommendation.body: Extend the existing plugin tab descriptor contract with token launch behavior, keep plugin pages sandboxed, and avoid a parallel public API.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the host-hook foundation and the broader Control UI contribution RFC, making them the best history-backed owner for the API-shape decision.
